create_infographic_vqa_dataset: create an InfographicVQA dataset instance with data_root, data_prefix, and ann_file arguments
load_infographic_vqa_data_list: load the InfographicVQA data list by calling load_data_list to parse annotations into question and image path dicts
register_infographic_vqa_module: register the InfographicVQA class in the DATASETS registry using the DATASETS.register_module decorator
review_infographic_vqa_class: review the InfographicVQA class that extends BaseDataset and loads infographic VQA annotations from a JSON file
summarize_infographic_vqa_load_data_list: summarize the load_data_list method that extracts questions, image paths, and ground truth answers from annotation JSON
